services.name: Shark Fishing
services.desc: Ready to get on the water?Book your inshore fishing charter today and experience some of the best light-tackle fishing Maine has to offer. Take your fishing adventure to the next level with our Maine shark fishing charters. Head offshore into deeper waters for an unforgettable, adrenaline-pumping experience targeting some of the ocean’s most powerful predators. Shark fishing is a hands-on, high-energy experience. After heading offshore, we’ll set up a chum slick to attract sharks and get ready for action. Once hooked up, be prepared-these fish put up an incredible fight.
